summary: Verified the two newly-added features on the DÇK-EÖS app: (1) Sepet — Save Custom Basket with localStorage persistence, and (2) Kırılım — Division Heatmap. Both work end-to-end. All acceptance criteria in the review request are met.

sepet_save_custom_basket.load_repopulates_13_weights: weight-01 changed from 5 -> 24.4 after clicking Yükle
sepet_save_custom_basket.invalid_sum_shows_error_toast_and_preven: Toast: 'Ağırlıklar 100 olmalı veya normalize edilmeli'; row not created

kirilim_division_heatmap.colors_visible_in_screenshot: green (positive) and red (negative) cells rendered per screenshot

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: data-testids containing spaces (saved-basket-Benim Sepetim) work but are fragile; consider slugifying names for testids.
Basket.tsx useEffect dependency on `custom` alongside `Object.keys(custom).length === 0` guard is fine but eslint-disable + custom in deps could cause re-init edge cases; current guard prevents it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (saved baskets in /sepet, division heatmap in /kirilim) verified working. localStorage key: 'savedBaskets'. Heatmap columns dynamically adjust to selected global date range.
